title: Sign in to your gym
forgotPassword: Forgot your password? Ask your gym to reset it. Gym owners can reset their own password using the server CLI.
magicHint: Use a link sent to your email address to sign in.
sent: Check your email. If this address can sign in, a link is on its way.
failed: Unable to sign in. Check your details and try again.
rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.
unavailable: Sign-in is currently unavailable. Contact your gym for help.
loadFailed: Unable to load your gym. Please try again.
error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
noAccess: Your account does not have staff access.
selectSuggestion: Select a household from the suggestions.
suggestionsHelp: Use the arrow keys and Enter to select.
noSuggestions: No matching households. Try another name.
linkUsed: This sign-in link was already used or has expired. Request a new one below.
linkNoAccount: No login here uses that address. Check it, or ask your gym to invite you.
linkFailed: That sign-in link didn't work. Request a new one below.
